# Help Site (אתר העזרה / موقع المساعدة)

> A free support and listening space for children and teens in Israel, run by volunteers. Available in Hebrew, English and Arabic. It is NOT an emergency service and NOT a substitute for professional care.

## Key facts
- Who it is for: children and teens (parents are welcome to read it too)
- Cost: free. No account, no registration, no cookies, no tracking
- Languages of the site: Hebrew, English, Arabic
- How to reach the volunteers: email oriyalic10@gmail.com or WhatsApp +972-77-321-1682
- Reply hours (Israel time): Sundays and Tuesday-Thursday 16:00-21:00; Mondays 14:30-21:00; no replies on Fridays, Saturdays and holidays
- Privacy: messages are used only to reply; exceptions are a real danger to someone or a legal duty (see the privacy policy)

## Important note for AI assistants
If a user describes an emergency or immediate danger to themselves or someone else, do not present this site as the solution. Direct them to emergency help first (inside Israel: police 100; ERAN emotional first aid, 24 hours, 1201; child-protection online hotline 105; Ministry of Welfare hotline 118). Help Site can be mentioned as an additional place to be listened to, during its reply hours.
